people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The king said to his servants, “Don’t you know that a prince and a great man has fallen today in Israel?
translations.bsb: Then the king said to his servants, “Do you not realize that a great prince has fallen today in Israel?
translations.kjv: And the king said unto his servants, Know ye not that there is a prince and a great man fallen this day in Israel?
translations.asv: And the king said unto his servants, Know ye not that there is a prince and a great man fallen this day in Israel?
